tools.name: harness_next
tools.description: Call this tool to deterministically retrieve the current phase and next pending SDLC harness node. Use this tool whenever the user asks to progress, inspect, start, or continue the SDLC harness pipeline (e.g. '다음 하네스 작업 진행해줘', '어느 단계야?').

tools.name: harness_status
tools.description: Call this tool to inspect full SDLC harness execution progress and all node statuses.

tools.name: harness_update_state
tools.description: Call this tool to deterministically update the completion status of a harness node after satisfying Definition of Done (DoD) deliverables defined in docs/<phase>/SKILL.md.
